After mdoc restores your values, keep the street and unit details in B03 and the locality and postal code in B04. Reformat your birth date in B11 as month-day-year (`MM-DD-YYYY`).

Enter your Singapore tax number directly in B08. Sign B15 and enter the date you sign in `MM-DD-YYYY` format. Give the completed form to your brokerage.
